verdict.rationale: Termius docs explicitly state saved hosts store IPs/ports/passwords so users connect instantly without re-entering credentials, backed by a Keychain that stores credentials for reuse across hosts and syncs across devices. Community feedback corroborates core reliability (used in the field, from phone) though raises unrelated performance/security concerns. Missing for 10: no explicit hands-on confirmation of literally 'one tap' UX or independent benchmarking of connection speed.
